phase: roadmap step 1b — GPU-parallel simulation + PPO track
goal: Batched GPU simulation of Walker2d for fast wall-clock iteration, and to enable the CMA-ES LUT-from-scratch arm (roadmap step 3), whose cost is dominated by rollouts.

engine.why: runs the same MuJoCo model and dynamics as Walker2d-v5 — loads the identical walker2d_v5.xml — so the comparison against the SAC reference stays honest
brax_rejected_because: brax warns on import that it is not actively maintained (points to MJX / mujoco_playground)
brax's PPO calls the removed jax.device_put_replicated and crashes on jax 0.11

solver.note: the reduced solver adds +0.3% on top of the MJX-vs-MuJoCo-C engine gap, which exists at any solver setting

ppo.implementation: purejaxrl-style, hand-written (ppo_mjx.py) — brax's PPO is unusable on jax 0.11

throughput_env_steps_per_sec.note: env-steps, NOT physics steps (frame_skip=4). Fusing the 4 frame-skip steps into one jitted lax.scan was worth 3x.

env_vars_required.XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE: false — else JAX grabs ~75% of VRAM
env_vars_required.MUJOCO_GL: glfw — EGL throws EGLError on this box, osmesa not installed

status: COMPLETE — baseline established; ready for the LUT policy arms (roadmap steps 2-3)
